mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can lower seizure threshold and reduce primidone efficacy, while primidone induces metabolism of amphotericin B and may mask toxicity symptoms through CNS depression.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (potassium, magnesium), and seizure control closely; consider liposomal amphotericin B formulation; maintain adequate electrolyte supplementation and seizure threshold awareness.
